paite: Hiai tengteng ka lungtang in ka vei ngal a, hiai tengteng zongkhe ding in; midiktatte leh mipilte leh athilhihte uh Pathian khut ah a-om ahi chih; itna ahi hia muhdahna, mihing in athei kei; ama uah avek in a-om hi.
heading: Nuamtak In Om In

paite: Thil tengteng kibang in avek ua kiang ah ahong om a; midiktatte leh migiloute tung ah tanchin khat a-om hi; mihoih kiang leh migilou kiang, misiang kiang leh misiang lou kiang, kithoihmi kiang leh kithoihloumi kiang ah, mihoih a-om bang in, mikhial a-om a; akichiampa, thuchiam kihtapa bang in.

Ni nuai ah hih a om tengteng ah hiai gilou ahi, bang teng tung a tanchin khat om; ahi nalai a, mite tapate lungtang gilou in adim a, adam lai uh alungtang uah lungsim kimlouhna a-om, huai nung in misite kiang ah apai uh.
Amah hing lai tengteng toh kizom a om ding in lah lametna a-om ngal a; humpinelkai sisa sang in ui hing lai lah ahoihzaw ngal a.
Mihingte'n asi ding uh chih lah athei ngal ua; himahleh misi in thil himhim athei kei, kipahman leng aneita kei uhi; amaute theihgigena lah akimangngilh hi.
A-itna uh bang in, amuhdahna uleh a-enna uh tu in amangta a; ni nuai a hih a om thil himhim ah tangtawn in tantuan anei nawnta kei uhi.
Pai inla, nopsakna toh na tanghou ne inla, lungtang kipak toh in na uain dawn in; Pathian in lah na thilhihte asang khinta ngal a.
Na puansilhte ngou gige in om hen; huan na lu in nilh theih tasam kei hen.

Na bangmah lou damsung ni tengteng a na it na zi kiang ah kipaktak in om inla, huai ama'n ni nuai a ahon piak, na bangmah lou ni tengteng in; huai lah damsung in na tantuan ahi ngal a, ni nuai a na sepgimna a na sepgimna ah.
Na khut in hih ding bangpeuh amuh na theihtawp in sem in; na paina lam han sung ah, nasep hiam, thil ngaihtuah hiam, theihna hiam, pilna hiam a-om lou ding ahi ngal a.

Ka kihei a, kitaitehna kinte a ding ahi kei a, galdouna hatte a ding ahi tuan kei chih ka mu hi, tanghou leng apilte a ding, hauhsakna leng theisiam mite a ding, deihsakna khutsiamte a ding hi tuan lou; himahleh hun leh phat amaute tengteng tung ah ahong om zel hi.
Mihing in ahun athei kei hi; ngasate len gilou a akimat bang leh vasate thang a a-awk uh bang in, huchibang in mite tapate, amau tung a thakhat a ahong tun guih lai in, hun gilou a mat in a-om uhi.
Hichibang in pilna leng ni nuai ah ka mu a, ka kiang ah thupi in akilang hi.
heading: Pilna Leh Haina Ngaihtuahnate

paite: Khopi lian lou a-om a, asung ah mi tawmchik; huan kumpipa thupi in ahong sim a, ala a, adouna ding in sepaih nasep thupitak abawl hi.
Huchi in huai ah mipil genthei khat a-om, apilna in khopi ahunkhia a; himahleh kuamah in huai migentheipa atheigige kei uh.
Huan ke'n, "Hatna sang in pilna ahoihzaw; migenthei pilna muhsit in a-om a, athute ngaihkhiaksak in a-om kei," ka chi hi.
Mihaite lak a vaihawmmi kikou sang in awl a mipil thugente akiza zaw hi.
Kidouna galvante sang in pilna ahoihzaw; himahleh mikhial khat in hoih tampi ahihsia hi.
